Job Type: Full-time, Contract (W-9 / 1099 Independent Contractor)
Pay: $25.00 – $35.00 per hour
Location: Remote — US and Canada based applicants only

Take Your Salesforce Career to the Next Level with Us
AutomationFix, a growing HubSpot and Salesforce managed service provider based in the US, is seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Salesforce Administrator with 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience to join our remote team. This is an excellent opportunity for a certified Salesforce professional ready to take ownership of complex client builds, deepen their expertise, and advance their CRM career in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Role Overview
As a Senior Salesforce Administrator, you'll leverage your experience and certifications to design, build, and maintain Salesforce orgs across our diverse client base. This role is designed for a confident administrator who can own technical decisions, lead Flow development, and deliver high-quality solutions. You'll work directly with clients, providing strategic guidance and hands-on implementation, while gaining exposure to a wide variety of industries and use cases.

We're looking for someone who comes in strong on implementation and has the foundation to grow toward solution architecture over time.

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Administration: Manage and maintain client Salesforce orgs, applying best practices for data management, security, system configuration, and platform optimization.
Flow Development: Design and build Salesforce Flows (Record-Triggered, Screen, Scheduled, and Autolaunched), validation rules, and other declarative automations to meet client requirements.
Client Interaction and Relationship Building: Conduct regular client communications via Slack and scheduled meetings, strengthening your client management and consulting skills.
Project Management: Utilize ClickUp to manage project workflows, ensuring timely delivery and organized task management across multiple client accounts.
Solution Design and Implementation: Design and implement Salesforce CRM solutions, including custom objects, automations, integrations, and reporting, drawing on your experience to deliver real results.
Technical Support: Provide timely and effective troubleshooting and technical support, applying your problem-solving skills to resolve client issues efficiently.
Strategic Planning: Participate in weekly client calls to review progress, plan upcoming tasks, and contribute to strategic CRM planning discussions.

Qualifications

Minimum 2 years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience. We'll also consider candidates with roughly 1 year of agency or consulting experience combined with a background in business or sales operations.
Active Salesforce Certified Administrator (ADM 201) certification required.
Strong experience building and maintaining Salesforce Flows (Record-Triggered, Screen, and Scheduled).
Proficiency with validation rules, formula fields, custom objects, and declarative automation.
Solid understanding of the Salesforce security model, including profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing settings.
Experience with Sales Cloud; working knowledge of Service Cloud or other Salesforce products is a strong plus.
Strong organizational skills with a keen attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the confidence and poise to lead calls with client executives.
Ability to work independently and stay productive in a remote environment.
Experience with project management software, preferably ClickUp.

Nice to Have (Not Required)

HubSpot experience. Extra credit, not a dealbreaker. Most Salesforce work eventually touches HubSpot, and familiarity with both platforms sets you up well for growth here.
Agency or consulting background. Time at an agency means exposure to many orgs, industries, and use cases, which we value highly.
Business or sales operations experience. Understanding the business case behind a build, not just the technology, is a real differentiator on our team.

What You'll Gain

Full-time remote work flexibility.
Continued growth: Work on diverse Salesforce builds across multiple industries and expand your expertise.
Career advancement: Real potential for expanded scope and responsibility within a fast-growing company.
Exposure to a wide range of clients and industries.
A collaborative and supportive team environment.

Grow your Salesforce career with AutomationFix. If you're a certified, proactive professional with strong Salesforce administration experience and a drive to keep learning, we encourage you to apply. We're committed to providing the opportunities and support you need to thrive.

Pay: $25.00 - $35.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote
